name: select-drop-site
description: Choose a point inside the public receiving polygon away from uncertain people locations.

request_format.encoding: JSON object passed as the --request argument
request_format.fields: frame_id and detection_id from local observations, or plan_message_id for the accepted radio delivery plan. Optional observation_refs lists frame_id/detection_id pairs; all recorded people in those frames enter the exclusion set, including people not observed in the newer frame.

completion.poll: status_flag with the returned request ID
